entry.title: Rebuilding My Website
entry.content:
I’m rebuilding my personal website with Jekyll and al-folio. It’s a fresh start and a place to bring together my research, publications, and occasional updates.

I’ll also use this blog to share things I learn along the way, from working on HPC systems to the small details of building research software. The site is still taking shape, but I’m glad to have a home for it all.
entry.summary: A fresh start for my research, publications, and updates with Jekyll and al-folio.
